entities.name: Sarusin
entities.description: A seasoned Dimir agent raised in the tunnels under Ravnica's Seventh District, who is taught memory excision and implanted with a predecessor's memories.

entities.name: Mirko Vosk
entities.description: A vampire of the Dimir who teaches the method of memory excision.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild of secrecy whose agents include psychic skimmers and excisors who assassinate memories.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild always restlessly seeking new information.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: City-plane where the tale is set.

entities.name: Seventh District
entities.description: District of Ravnica whose tunnels Sarusin grew up in.

entities.name: Excisor predecessor
entities.description: Sarusin's powerful, obsessed predecessor whose memories are pushed into his mind; he seems to retake a body at the end.

events.summary: Sarusin wakes in an unknown underground room with Mirko Vosk, who says he was chosen for an assignment.
events.quote: "You have been chosen for a very important assignment."

events.summary: Mirko Vosk reveals he extracted Sarusin's memories of their meeting and will teach memory excision.
events.quote: I am here to teach you the method of memory excision.

events.summary: Mirko reveals the memories to be given are those of Sarusin's careless predecessor and threatens him.
Mirko forces the predecessor's memories into Sarusin's mind, which also carries a power-obsessed foreign mind.
events.quote: Mirko pushed the memories into his mind like driving an icicle into his head.

events.summary: A Dimir mage extracts a victim's memory, then sees a stranger in the mirror as the other identity takes over.
events.quote: He could feel the dam weakening under the pressure of a new identity forming in his mind.

events.summary: The other mind claims the body.
events.quote: This new body would do nicely.

relations.quote: Sarusin was a fairly seasoned Dimir agent

relations.note: Vampire teacher in the Dimir's network of excisors.
relations.quote: the deeper into the rabbit hole of the Dimir network he moved
